name: RPN Calc
author: NucleoOS
description: A reverse Polish notation calculator in the HP tradition: unlimited stack, undo, memory, trigonometry in degrees or radians, logarithms, powers and factorials. The stack is kept between sessions.

descriptions.en: A reverse Polish notation calculator in the HP tradition: unlimited stack, undo, memory, trigonometry in degrees or radians, logarithms, powers and factorials. The stack is kept between sessions.
descriptions.it: Una calcolatrice in notazione polacca inversa, nella tradizione HP: pila illimitata, annulla, memoria, trigonometria in gradi o radianti, logaritmi, potenze e fattoriali. La pila resta tra una sessione e l'altra.
